import os
os.makedirs('programs',exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Recolor large uniform rectangular patches (at least 5x5) to 4.
    for r1 in range(h):
        for c1 in range(w):
            v=grid[r1][c1]
            for r2 in range(r1+4,h):
                for c2 in range(c1+4,w):
                    if all(grid[r][c]==v for r in range(r1,r2+1) for c in range(c1,c2+1)):
                        # only take maximal rectangles: no same-valued extension
                        if r1 and all(grid[r1-1][c]==v for c in range(c1,c2+1)): continue
                        if c1 and all(grid[r][c1-1]==v for r in range(r1,r2+1)): continue
                        if r2+1<h and all(grid[r2+1][c]==v for c in range(c1,c2+1)): continue
                        if c2+1<w and all(grid[r][c2+1]==v for r in range(r1,r2+1)): continue
                        for r in range(r1,r2+1):
                            for c in range(c1,c2+1): out[r][c]=4
    return out
'''
open('programs/task-9d406bdf.py','w').write(code)
print('written')
